protocol.name: psyclyx_color_management_v1
protocol.copyright: SPDX-FileCopyrightText: © 2026 The River Developers SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
protocol.description:
This is a PRIVATE, non-standard protocol. The "psyclyx" namespace marks it as a personal extension carried by one river fork; it is not a river or Wayland standard and carries no compatibility promise. Do not implement it in other compositors or clients expecting stability.
It lets a trusted client assign a display ICC profile to an individual output as a color transform applied after blending, correcting the composited image for that physical panel. This is display calibration/ output policy, deliberately kept out of the standard color-management protocol (which the ecosystem routes through colord); this protocol exists because river has no config surface for per-output color and no colord integration.
The lifecycle mirrors wlr-gamma-control: a client takes exclusive control of an output's color via a per-output object, and the correction is bound to that object's lifetime. Destroying the object — or the client disconnecting — reverts the output to uncorrected. Killing the controlling process is thus a reliable undo.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the manager. Any output color objects created through it are unaffected and retain control of their outputs.

request.name: get_output_color

description.summary: take color control of an output

request.description:
Create an object to control the color correction of the given output.
Only one client may control a given output's color at a time. If the output is already controlled, or is otherwise unavailable (invalid, or the renderer lacks output color transform support), the returned object is immediately sent the failed event and is inert; the client should destroy it.

interface.name: psyclyx_color_management_output_v1

description.summary: color control for a single output

interface.description: Controls the color correction of one output. The correction persists for as long as this object lives; destroying it (or disconnecting) reverts the output to an uncorrected (identity) transform.

event.name: failed

description.summary: color control could not be acquired

event.description: Sent at most once, if control of the output could not be acquired (already controlled by another client, output invalid, or unsupported). The object is inert: further requests other than destroy are ignored.

request.name: set_icc_profile

description.summary: apply an ICC profile to the output

request.description:
Build a color transform from the ICC profile whose bytes are found in the file descriptor at [offset, offset + length), and apply it to the output after blending, replacing any transform previously set through this object.
The fd is not retained: its contents are read synchronously and the compositor closes its copy when the request returns. length must be greater than zero and at most 64 MiB. A profile that cannot be read or is not a usable ICC profile is ignored (and logged); no error is raised, leaving whatever correction was previously in effect.

arg.name: icc_fd
arg.summary: file descriptor holding the ICC profile

arg.name: offset
arg.summary: byte offset of the profile within the fd

arg.name: length
arg.summary: length of the profile in bytes

request.name: destroy
request.description: Revert the output to an uncorrected transform and destroy the object.
